'''Ben Moordriver''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He made a living selling sand sculptures out of the back of his [[Speeder truck/Legends|repulsortruck]].
